bear.b: FTC Solar remains far from breakeven despite some improvement from prior periods. Very low or negative gross margins leave little room to absorb pricing pressure or execution costs, while sustained operating losses make growth dependent on achieving substantial margin improvement.

Ongoing cash burn means revenue growth is not yet translating into internally funded operations. Continued negative free cash flow can constrain investment and working capital, increase dependence on external financing, and make execution more vulnerable if profitability does not improve.
